description: This file contains implementation code for a pseudo-merge system within a version control context, specifically for Git. It includes functions for configuration, group sizing, selecting pseudo-merge commits, and applying pseudo-merge logic to commit bitmaps. The code is involved in managing and processing commit references, patterns, and bitmap operations for efficient merge simulation or analysis.

classes.description: Represents a group configuration for pseudo-merge operations, including patterns, decay, size thresholds, and matches.

classes.name: pseudo_merge_matches
classes.description: Holds sets of stable and unstable commits matching certain pattern criteria within a group.

classes.description: Represents an extended pseudo-merge commit data structure for handling additional metadata.

classes.name: pseudo_merge_commit
classes.description: Stores positional and offset information for a pseudo-merge commit in the pseudo-merge mapping.
